title: race
description: One contest for one seat in one cycle: every House district, the Senate seats up and their specials, and President every fourth year. Partitioned by cycle.

race_id.description: The race's id, `{cycle}-{office}-{state}-{district}`, then `-special` for a special election.

cycle.description: The two-year election cycle, named by its even year.

jurisdiction.description: The regulator whose rules and ids the row follows. `US` (the FEC) for every row of v1.

office.description: The office, `H` House, `S` Senate or `P` President.

state.description: The state, two letters; `US` for President.

district.description: The House district, two digits; `00` for an at-large seat, the Senate and President.

slug.description: The race's slug, `{cycle}/{house|senate|president}/{STATE}[-{DD}][-special]`, from which fundlens.org builds the path of the race's page.
